largeheadline_copy.line2:
Surgical Planning

The first patient specific instrumentation for Total Ankle Replacement.1

text_copy_copy.text: CONTACT US

text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text_652839079.text: Through the combination of computer imaging and the patient’s own CT scan, a patient-specific preoperative plan is developed. Implant sizing and alignment are determined using the patient’s unobstructed anatomic landmarks and the surgeon’s preferences. Prophecy guides are then created which set resection guide locations, reducing intraoperative steps to simplify surgery.

numbercounter_copy_c.counterlabel:
+ cases…
and counting

text_1195646292_copy.text: Prophecy is compatible with Stryker's Infinity, Inbone and Invision total ankle implants, offering a continuum of care including low profile primaries, complex deformities, and revisions.
Exhibiting a history of innovation and clinical success: Prophecy guides increase the alignment accuracy while reducing surgical and fluoroscopic steps.

numbercounter_copy.counterlabel: post-op neutral alignment achievable3

numbercounter_copy_c.counterlabel: reduction in operative cost per case4

text_copy_copy_copy.text: 1. The patient receives a CT following the Prophecy CT scan

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: 2. Preoperative plan is generated according to surgeon preferences
3. Preoperative plan is approved by surgeon through Prophecy website. The plan may be altered if desired.
4. A 3D printing machine produces patient specific high resolution nylon guides. The guides are then sent out for surgery.
5. Surgery is performed in accordance with the preoperative plan.

text.text:
Prophecy pin-through

  • Surface match technology
  • De-coupled tibia and talar cut
  • Guide placement and resection performed separately

text_copy_845316740.text:
Prophecy resect through

  • Surface match technology
  • One guide utilized for both pinning and resecting the Infinity Total Ankle to reduce operating time
  • Corner pegs protect against notching
  • Option to couple talar alignment

text.text:
Prophecy 3D Planner allows the surgeon to review, edit, and simulate their Prophecy plan in real time.

Available for US only.

text_copy.text:
Prophecy 3D Viewer allows Surgeons to view their Prophecy plan in 3D on a desktop or iPad.

Available in countries where Prophecy is available.

text_copy_copy.text:
Prophecy Footprint™ Surgical Planning is an add-on service to the standard Prophecy system, that can provide an understanding of the ancillary procedures to be considered for ESAA patients with concomitant pathology.

By facilitating a more comprehensive view of the foot around the ankle, Footprint can help surgeons with their most complex patient populations.
